backlog.title: Bugfix changeset 001_3e88fb340e1d: full-fidelity restart replay, Other-row width safety, observable auto-submit confirmation, SURFACE-002 comment truth
backlog.description: Fix the 4 validated defects in pi-interrogator at HEAD 3a302a9 (1624 tests green). BUG-001 (Major): interrogation-submission deltas carry answer.value only — restart reconstruction inside a missed 2s mirror-flush window silently drops answer.text elaborations and answer.custom write-in markers, degrading the read surface, ANSWER-PIN-001 caret pinning, WRITEIN-001 ✎ markers, and the FR-5 completion record; fix = extend DiffEntry at BOTH producers (computeEntries + the actions.ts synthetic seam) with optional text/custom and apply them in replaySubmission, plus the PRD-required regression test. BUG-002: otherLine never truncates OTHER_AFFORDANCE — panel lines overflow sub-32-col terminals. BUG-003: maybeAutoSubmit flashes 'submitted — {n} answer(s)' after submit()'s panel.suspend() — dead on an unmounted component; route an observable confirmation (post-suspend notify channel or final frame). BUG-004: index.ts createReconstruction wiring comment still claims session_start auto-opens the panel, contradicting locked ruling SURFACE-002. spec/ is read-only locked prose; no PRD-external behavior changes.

milestones.title: BUG-001: submission deltas carry and replay the full answer shape (text + custom)
